CORE EXPLANATION

mod divides code into namespaces, `pub` exposes visibility, and `use` brings names into scope. Keeping the file layout aligned with the module tree improves navigation. A Cargo workspace coordinates related crates and a shared lockfile while each crate retains its public API and dependency boundaries.
